The type of research is a quasi-experiment with a three treatment counterbalanced design research design. The instruments used: (1) students 'initial mathematical ability tests, (2) tests of students' mathematical problem-solving abilities with the Pythagorean Theorem material. Inferential data were performed using covariance analysis (ANACOVA). The samples of this study were 32 students each from three experimental classes selected by purposive sampling. The results are: (1) of the three learning models conducted using the model of problem-based learning, discovery learning, and open-ended had a positive effect on the ability to solve mathematical problems; (2) the ability to solve mathematical problems of students taught by problem-based learning models is better than the using discovery learning and open-ended models; and (3) there is an interaction between the initial ability of mathematics and learning models.</jats:p>\", \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.31764/jtam.v4i1.1736\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2020, 4, 24]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.5040/9798216526087.ch02\", \"title\": [\"Creative and Innovative Thinking\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.5040/9798216526087.ch02\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2013]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.1007/978-1-4614-7224-7_3\", \"title\": [\"Open-Ended Inquiry\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1007/978-1-4614-7224-7_3\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2013]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.3030/713010\", \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.3030/713010\"}]", "excerpt_truncated": false, "source_sha256": "0ddab8cc68bbfb70bd244dc166afbb4514826d349ed7ebc1f35c24719e5d7320", "verification_required": true, "topic_domain": "unassigned_problem", "evidence_role": "discovery", "host_tier": "discovery…

See [the reusable kernel contract](kernel.md) for application ownership and the
non-research execution proof, and [installation boundaries](installations.md) for
independent records and runtime lifecycles. These remain inside this repository.

The local [improvement application](improvements.md) uses that same kernel contract
in an explicitly new experiment record. Captured public research informs code
proposals; it does not become writable research authority. Untrusted candidate
code runs only in restricted disposable containers, while the host scores its
outputs. An operator review receipt cannot apply code or grant release authority.

The [autonomous context lane](autonomous-context.md) is a separate WAKE application
policy on the existing per-node native authority. An installed capability permits
one selector-field change, gated by recomputed fixed-task and current-native-state
measurements. Proposal generation, adoption and rollback require no per-change
human review. Metadata events preserve research versions and history; candidate
data cannot replace the evaluator, widen permissions, modify code or create a
competing research store. Native replay owns the policy after restart.

> **Current specification.** This document explains why the present system is shaped this way: its trust boundary, durable record, governance model and known limits. Current local procedures belong in `standalone.md`; public mirror publishing belongs in `cloud.md`. Maintainer navigation, environment checks and reproducible validation guidance belong in `development.md`.

**WAKE✳︎** is infrastructure for continuity of accountable work, not continuity of a model instance. Its stable sequence is **Record → Context → Proposal → Governance → Transition → Receipt**. Abstract
Di Zi Gui
, a Qing-era moral primer, is discussed in contemporary Chinese family education, school moral education, and classical-recitation initiatives. Existing accounts document heterogeneous uses but do not establish their current prevalence or effects on children’s autonomy. This Hypothesis and Theory article develops a conditional model through close reading of 34 purposively selected precept groups from one modern working edition and comparison with psychological research from other contexts. Textual evidence, theoretical inference, and predictions requiring empirical testing are distinguished throughout. Adultcentrism identifies a possible asymmetry in interpretive authority; self-determination theory supplies the core distinction between controlled compliance and endorsed commitment. Peer review is often portrayed as a consensus-driven process in which reviewer recommendations largely determine editorial decisions. Methods

We conducted a meta-research analysis of anonymized editorial data from Healthcare (MDPI, Basel, Switzerland; ISSN 2227-9032) (2021-2025), including manuscripts that were ultimately published and manuscripts rejected after external peer review. Reviewer recommendations (accept, minor revision, major revision, reject) were examined at the manuscript level across review rounds.
